title: A reptéren
intro: You play someone from Bucharest who lives in Budapest. You're waiting for a flight, and the person next to you starts chatting.

a.speaker: Utas
a.text: Jó napot! Ön is Bécsbe megy?
a.textEn: Hello! Are you going to Vienna too?

b.speaker: Utas
b.textEn: Bucharest! That's the capital of Romania, right?

choices.note: You're at Budapest airport! From Bucharest = bukaresti (-i).

b-oops.speaker: Utas
b-oops.textEn: Now? But you're in Budapest now!

c.speaker: Utas
c.textEn: Interesting! And where do you live?

choices.note: Budapest takes -en, like most Hungarian towns: Budapesten.

d.speaker: Utas
d.text: Én osztrák vagyok, Grazban élek. Milyen nyelven beszél?
d.textEn: I'm Austrian, I live in Graz. What languages do you speak?

choices.text: Románul, angolul és egy kicsit magyarul.
choices.textEn: Romanian, English and a little Hungarian.

choices.text: Igen: románul, angolul és egy kicsit magyarul.
choices.textEn: Yes: Romanian, English and a little Hungarian.

e.speaker: Utas
e.text: Nagyon jól beszél magyarul! Én is tanulok, de még nem tudok olyan jól.
e.textEn: You speak Hungarian very well! I'm learning too, but I'm not that good yet.

choices.text: Köszönöm! Szerintem a magyar nyelv nagyon érdekes.
choices.textEn: Thank you! I think Hungarian is very interesting.

choices.note: Modest! But you just had a whole conversation in Hungarian.

end-great.text: Your flight is called. Jó utat! (Have a good trip!)

end-ok.text: The traveller laughs: “Dehogynem!” (Of course you do!) Jó utat!
